exercises.why: **поехал** — пое́хать (perfective): to go (in a conveyance or on horseback); to ride, to drive; to travel; (figurative) to go mad/insane, to lose one's mind. Wiktionary: по- + е́хать.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **подал** — пода́ть (perfective): to give, to proffer, to pass; to serve; (sports) to pitch, to serve, to pass; to give alms. Wiktionary: по- + дать.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **Подай** — пода́ть (perfective): to give, to proffer, to pass; to serve; (sports) to pitch, to serve, to pass; to give alms. Wiktionary: по- + дать.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to put, to place, to set, to stand, to station (In a vertical position)
to go (in a conveyance or on horseback)
to give, to proffer, to pass
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: поста́вить — to put, to place, to set, to stand, to station (In a vertical position); пое́хать — to go (in a conveyance or on horseback); попа́сть — to hit (a target); пода́ть — to give, to proffer, to pass.
